name: newReporting
label: Fetch data from new reporting
description: Fetch data from new reporting API

name: enableAddZerosAtApi
label: Show 0 when no data available
description: Choose the display format when there is no value in the selected dataset or for the configuration

name: additionalGroupByConfig
label: Alternative Group By
description: Alternative group by settings

name: showHeader
label: Show header
description: Displays the visualization header, including title and icons.

name: lineClamp
label: Line of truncation
description: The number of lines the header can use before it’s truncated. Long headers will be cut off with an ellipsis after the selected number of lines.

name: headerTitleAlignment
label: Title alignment
description: Title alignment in horizontal direction

name: wrapTitle
label: Wrap title
description: Wraps long titles onto a second line. If false, displays an ellipses to truncate long title.

name: showLoadingIndicator
label: Show loading indicator
description: Displays the loading indicator.

name: showHeaderSeparator
label: Show header separator
description: Displays a line separating the header from the rest of the component.

name: contextMenuActions
label: Pass additional context menu actions in the header
description: Allows the user to pass additional context menu actions in the header of the Data visualization component

name: headerTitle
label: Chart title
description: Title for the visualization.

name: headingLevel
label: Heading level
description: HTML heading tag level of the header title (H1 to H6).

name: description
label: Description
description: Fill in a short overview of the visualization that the end user sees.

name: showBorder
label: Show border
description: Displays a line around the component.

name: groupByConfig
label: Configuration of the group by field
description: Configures the group by behavior.

name: bareBorder
label: Bare
description: If true, removes padding around data visualization to provide more compact positioning on the page.

name: showDataPassthrough
label: Define data manually
description: Allows pass data/values directly to the chart using json format instead of using standard data sources.

name: refreshRequest
label: Refresh requested
description: A string that can be passed down to trigger a data refresh. Refresh will be triggered only if the new value of this property is different from the previous one.

name: showAdditionalGroupBySelector
label: Selector visible by default
description: When enabled the group by selector is visible on the data visualization. Otherwise, additional group by options are under the three-dot menu.

name: allowAdditionalGroupByPerMetric
label: Allow additional group by per metric
description: Allow additional group by selection per metric when multiple metrics are added.

name: sortBy
label: Sort by
description: Defines the attribute used to sort groups or categories.

name: sortByOrder
label: Sort by order
description: Specifies whether to sort groups or categories in ascending or descending order.

name: showChange
label: Show change
description: Shows the change compared to the previous score or period.

name: showChangePercentage
label: Show change %
description: Shows the change percentage compared to the previous score or period.

name: showTarget
label: Show target
description: Displays the global target value. Target will only appear if it is defined for the indicator.

name: showForecast
label: Show forecast
description: Displays forecast data in the chart based on current trend data.

name: forecastConfig
label: Forecast Configuration
description: Configure the forecast settings

name: showForecastRange
label: Show forecast range
description: Displays the 95% confidence interval of the forecast.

name: showTrend
label: Show trend
description: Displays the direction the indicator is moving, or how values have changed over time.

name: showConfidenceBand
label: Show confidence band
description: Displays the bandwidth between which indicator scores are moving.

name: showGapPercentage
label: Show gap %
description: Shows the percentage between the current value and the target value.

name: showSparkline
label: Show sparkline
description: Shows a line graph representing the change over time.

name: showMetricLabel
label: Show metric label
description: Shows the metric label.

name: showThreshold
label: Show threshold
description: Displays an active threshold set for the selected indicator, such as an all-time high or low. Thresholds appear only if they have been defined for the selected indicator.

name: showComment
label: Show comment
description: Displays comments added to data points.

name: showTotalValue
label: Show total value
description: Toggles the display of the overall total value of the visualization.

name: followFilters
label: Follow filters
description: Follow filters set for a page. When enabled, the visualization displays on a workspace with the filters set by the page. Toggle off to disable a visualization from accepting any filter input.

name: showFilterIcon
label: Show filter icon
description: Show the filter icon and the number of filters impacting the visualization. If a filter is not selected to apply to a visualization, the icon does not show. Toggle off to hide the filter icon and number of filters applied.

name: enableRealTimeUpdate
label: Real time update
description: Updates score in real time.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: enableClickAndStay
label: Show selected data point
description: Use setting to visually show data point that has been selected/clicked on. Often can be used when the chart is acting as filter.

name: showDataTable
label: Show data table
description: Shows a table with chart and graph data for easier screen reader access.

name: enableCustomEmptyState
label: Set custom message when no data
description: When selected, user can configure custom no data message

name: emptyStateIllustration
label: Illustration
description: Name of the illustration to use

name: emptyStateHeading
label: Heading
description: Heading of the no data message

name: emptyStateHeadingLevel
label: Heading level
description: Heading level of the no data message (H1 to H6).

name: emptyStateContent
label: Content
defaultValue: There are no scores available for the selected criteria. Contact your admin for more info.
description: Secondary text to display in the no data message

name: emptyStateAlignment
label: Alignment
description: Sets the alignment

name: backgroundRefreshInterval
label: Refresh after being away for X min.
description: If user was away from the page, staying in the experience for time longer than specified, visualization will be refreshed upon return to the page.

name: showMaximumRange
label: Show maximum range
description: Shows the maximum range of available dates.

name: allowChangeDateRange
label: Allow change date range
description: Show the date range selector control on the data visualization to allow user quickly change date range from the predefined options.

name: showDateRangeByDefault
label: Show range picker by default
description: When enabled the date range selector is visible on the data visualization. Otherwise, it is still available under the "More options" menu.

name: applyDateRange
label: Apply date range
description: Allows apply date range filter from filter component or manual configuration to data visualization.

name: chartExtraConfig
label: Extra Chart Config
description: additional chart configuration

name: numberOfPeriods
label: Number of periods
description: Number of date periods to display.

name: showAbsolutePeriod
label: Set absolute period
description: Sets an absolute start and end date for the date range.

name: autoAggregatePeriods
label: Automatically aggregate periods
description: Automatically picks the best aggregation period when a date filter is used. Affects only this visualization and does not change the indicator's default aggregation period. Clear the checkbox to always use the indicator's default period.

name: scoreType
label: Show data for selected period as
description: Defines indicator aggregation logic on how scores for selected period will be shown.

name: showChangeFrom
label: Show change from
description: Allows to define if the change in single score will be calculated comparing to  the previous score or comparing to period start.

name: startTime
label: Start time
description: Start date for the absolute period.

name: endTime
label: End time
description: End date for the absolute period.

name: useCurrentDateForEnd
label: Use current date for period end
description: When enabled, the period end date automatically updates to the current date. If the period start date is set to a future date, the toggle will be disabled. Reset the period start date to a past or present date to enable the toggle again.

name: period
label: Period
description: Time interval for each date period.

name: useDataCache
label: Use data cache
description: Original load of data visualization will use visualization cache data when available to ensure better performance. User can get current data on demand by using "Refresh button".

name: cacheExpirationTime
label: Cache expiration time (h)
description: Setting defines the time that cache will be valid. If existing cache is older than specified time the new query will be used instead and new cache created.

name: showCacheTime
label: Show cache time
description: Show icon indication on the data visualization when returned data are from cache. On hover of the icon user can see how old are the data.

name: isComponentInView
label: Is component in view
description: Passes outer macroponent isComponentInView to the base vis prop. Hidden in UI, used for transaction cancellation when component is not in view

name: pageId
label: Page ID
description: It will accept an ID from the parent component and can be used to hold either a dashboard ID or a page ID. However, it is primarily used for holding the dashboard ID, which serves as an additional key for caching purposes.

name: showExtendedErrorMessages
label: Show extended error messages
description: Enable to show detailed error messages that are useful for admins and users with edit rights. Disable to show generic info messages.

name: dateFormat
label: Date format
description: Defines the date format for the X axis.

name: showRefresh
label: Show refresh option
description: Show refresh option in the context menu.

name: showExportOptions
label: Show export options
description: Show export options in the context menu.

name: showFilterAsSeparateSeries
label: Show filter as separate series
description: Toggle on to display each filter condition separately within the chart, allowing for detailed comparison across different metrics over time. This will only work for the first filter applied. Toggle off to combine the data from all filter conditions, providing an overview of overall trends.

name: userInfo
label: User information
description: User information provided by UXF context binding.

name: sharedContext
label: Shared Context
description: Metadata that can be reused across visualizations.

name: colors
label: Colors
description: Resolved colors to be used by visualizations
